summary: Retested the live frontend preview across all 23 sidebar modules, dashboard, global search, RFQ actions, theme toggle, desktop collapse, mobile drawer, and overflow.

integration_issues.issue: Both controls have data-testid values and appear interactive, but are non-button passive divs with no click feedback or menu.

action_items: Add company selector and profile dropdown feedback/menu behavior, or make their passive presentation explicit.
critical_code_review_comments: All records and actions remain static frontend mock behavior by design; no backend/API integration is present per scope.
Dashboard is a special view rather than a module table, so generic module contracts should not be applied to nav-dashboard.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing static mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 module routes rendered non-blank tables with records, toolbars, status badges, open actions and pagination. Global search opened Maintenance. Filter, columns, create, open, pagination, notifications, help and theme controls gave toast/state feedback. Mobile drawer and horizontal overflow passed. The first broad script reported nav-dashboard as a finding only because it incorrectly expected module-title; dashboard-title is the correct contract.
rca of the issue: Company selector and profile are rendered as div containers without onClick handlers or menu state in App.js. They therefore cannot satisfy the shell requirement that these controls provide interaction/feedback.
